lines.text: How is the front desk going? The guests will be here in about an hour.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: The lists are ready, and the pens are on the desk. I still need the name cards.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: I think the cards are in the green bag. Do you want me to look?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Yes, please. I can put the signs by the doors while you look.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: I found them. I can bring them to you in ten minutes.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: That works. I will leave some space on the left side of the desk.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Do we also need a chair for the guest who checks the names?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Yes, one chair is enough. I will get it after I put up the signs.
lines.speaker: Eli
